Rock duo Angine de Poitrine took home 5 Quebec music industry awards — and torched a hot dog on stage

Band members Khn and Klek from Saguenay, Que., won five of their six nominations at the 48th ADISQ Gala in Montreal. In true Angine de Poitrine fashion, they maintained their anonymity and acted out silent sketches — including using a polka-dotted blowtorch to cook a hot dog on stage.
